en.headline: Paul Chan warns geopolitical uncertainty poses downside risks at APEC meeting
en.dek: Hong Kong’s financial secretary told APEC finance ministers that while Asia’s growth is outpacing the world, concentration in AI-related assets and geopolitical disruptions require fiscal prudence and closer cooperation.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said on Tuesday that geopolitical uncertainties have brought downside risks to financial markets, speaking at a plenary session of the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting in Hong Kong.

He noted that the global economy has shown resilience but growth remains uneven and under strain. Asia continues to outpace global growth, supported by technology-related trade and investment. In Hong Kong, merchandise exports rose by more than 40 percent in value in the first eight months of the year, and around 70 percent of IPO proceeds were attributable to AI-related companies.

Chan cautioned that concentrating solely on AI-related assets could amplify market corrections across sectors and borders, while geopolitical disruptions would constrain fiscal space. He called for fiscal prudence, vigilant financial oversight and closer cooperation in information sharing, risk monitoring and emergency response. Sustained investment and open channels for trade and investment were also vital, he said.

zh.headline: 陳茂波APEC財長會警告地緣政治不確定性帶來下行風險
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波周二在香港舉行的APEC財長會議上指，亞太增長領先全球，但地緣政治不確定性及過度集中於AI相關資產或放大市場修正，需要財政審慎及更緊密合作。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波周二在亞太經合組織財政部長會議全體會議上表示，地緣政治不確定性為金融市場帶來下行風險，呼籲以審慎態度應對。
他指出，全球經濟雖展現韌性，但增長仍不均衡並受壓。亞洲繼續領先全球增長，受科技相關貿易及投資支撐。香港方面，今年首八個月貨物出口價值上升超過40%，約七成首次公開招股集資來自AI相關公司。
陳茂波警告，過度集中於AI相關資產可能放大跨行業及跨境的市場修正，而地緣政治乾擾會壓縮財政空間。他呼籲需要財政審慎、警覺金融監管，以及在資訊互享、風險監測及應急回應上更緊密合作。
